logros.descripcion: Obtain an ocarina for the first time as an adult.

logros.nombre: Aren't You a Bit Big to Be Here?
logros.descripcion: Defeat Queen Gohma as an Adult.
Escape Kokiri Forest WITHOUT beating the Deku Tree first.
Get into Zora's Fountain without giving King Zora Ruto's Letter
Enter Jabu-Jabu's belly without feeding him a fish.
Win the Chest Mini-Game grand prize without using the Lens of Truth.
Obtain the Gold Scale as a child.
Play a burning deku stick as an ocarina and let it burn down.
Enter the Bottom of the Well as a child before draining the well.
As a child complete the Dampe race and obtain the Hookshot.
As a child obtain the hoverboots from the Shadow Temple.
Obtain the Heart Piece above the graveyard as a child.
Obtain the mythical 37th heart piece in Gerudo Valley
Become an adult without opening the Door of Time.
Become a child again while the Door of Time is still closed. (Must start on the Stone Pedestal Side)
Collect the HP over Dodongo's cavern without planting the bean plant.
Enter Zora's Domain from Zora's River without playing Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall.
As an adult steal Epona from Lon Lon Ranch without winning the race against Ingo.
Unfreeze King Zora without using Blue Fire.
Cross the broken Gerudo Valley bridge without Epona or the Longshot.

logros.nombre: Legend of Zelda: Epona of Time and Space
logros.descripcion: Warp Epona to the island above the water temple using a warp song
Enter the Ganon's castle climb without breaking the barrier.

Enter the Water Temple before shooting the gem to open the gate.
Shoot the Water Temple Gate Gem in Lake Hylia without equipping the Iron Boots.

logros.nombre: Just Walk Right Up To It
